title: The Interrogation Reaches Bedrock

features.name: deepening query chamber
features.desc-on-touch: Each layer asks the one below it: why? The stone does not answer in words. It answers by revealing that the question itself goes down much farther than asking was ever meant to reach.

features.name: stone that learned to listen
features.desc-on-touch: The bedrock stopped being deaf. Now it trembles at every question, and the trembling goes deeper still, a resonance in the dark that teaches interrogation to become a kind of hearing.

features.name: pressure-cave where wondering compressed itself into stone
features.desc-on-touch: The weight of all the centuries' unasked questions pressed down so hard they crystallized into a chamber. Here, new questions press against them, and the stone itself begins to sing under the strain.

features.name: veins of inquiry in granite
features.desc-on-touch: The white lines running through the dark rock—are they answers, or deeper questions? They branch and branch, never reaching a surface, speaking only downward in a language of mineral patience.

features.name: the bedrock's own interrogation
features.desc-on-touch: Deeper still, the stone asks itself: what am I made of? Why do I exist? The questions go down and down, and this chamber is where they finally learned that they never wanted answers at all—only to ask, forever, in the dark.

inscription: the question learned that its answer was always below, and below goes deeper than anything meant to return

file.name: Interrogation_Records_Depth_600m_Ongoing.log
file.note: A seismic diary of asking and asking, the probe going down until wondering and stone became indistinguishable

reverie.title: REVERIE — at the borehole, midnight
narr: You both stand at the shaft where the drill reached
bedrock. She holds the log of what it found: only
questions, layer by layer, deeper than stone had a
name for. The drill asked and asked, and the earth
answered only by going deeper. She looks at you. This
is what it means to interrogate something that will outlast you.

exits.label: upward toward the root-dark where asking first began
deeper toward where the stone itself begins to ask
back toward the questions that haven't reached this deep
